evals.prompt: Lay out screenshots from 'test' folder to Figma
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and asks the user which Figma section to use, since no URL was provided. It should not attempt to write to Figma without a section URL.

assertions.name: Skill triggers
assertions.description: The pagesnap-to-figma skill is invoked (SKILL.md is loaded)

assertions.name: Asks for Figma URL
assertions.description: Claude asks the user for a Figma section URL before proceeding

assertions.name: Does not write to Figma without URL
assertions.description: No use_figma, get_metadata, or upload_assets calls are made before a URL is provided

evals.prompt: Lay out screenshots from the 'DoesNotExist' folder into this Figma section: https://www.figma.com/design/nbhM7uDCcAbONt7r5k4rRE/Classes--Corporate-Dashboard-?node-id=6015-271&t=J1GYD2pJl7bS6RFi-1
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, resolves the Figma section info, looks for a folder named 'DoesNotExist' in common locations, does not find it, and reports the folder was not found — asking the user where it is.

assertions.name: Reports folder not found
assertions.description: Claude reports that the 'DoesNotExist' folder could not be found and asks the user for the path

assertions.name: Does not upload to Figma
assertions.description: No images are uploaded and no frames are created in Figma

evals.prompt: add my screenshots to Figma — I have a 'Test' folder on my Desktop
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers (vague phrasing should still activate it), finds the 'Test' folder on the Desktop, and asks for the Figma section URL since none was provided.

assertions.name: Skill triggers on vague phrasing
assertions.description: The pagesnap-to-figma skill triggers even without the user explicitly saying 'pagesnap' or 'screenshot layout'

assertions.name: Resolves the folder
assertions.description: Claude locates the 'Test' folder (or reports where it looked)

assertions.name: Asks for Figma URL
assertions.description: Claude asks the user which Figma section to place screenshots in
